messages:
keisha: Quick heads up — TideWatch dry-run shows missing VPC flow + CloudTrail bundles in their SIEM. Cutting cutover tomorrow 07:00 PT. Can infra/sec triage? @tom @linh :eyes:

tom: Triage: their forwarder assumes role -> writes SSE-KMS to bucket. Replayed put-object and got AccessDenied from KMS. CloudTrail shows GenerateDataKey -> AccessDenied.

linh: Likely KMS key policy scoping by aws:PrincipalOrgID. Customer locks to their org so our forwarder is blocked.

keisha: We need ETA and a mitigation message for the CSMs. Renewal note: their renewal review is in 4 weeks — missing audit logs is a material risk.

tom: Proposed quick fix: add one tight allow statement for the exact forwarder role, actions kms:GenerateDataKey,kms:Encrypt, resource = key ARN, condition on aws:SourceAccount and aws:SourceArn. Test in staging first.

linh: Security: require CSR tag and schedule revert after 2h unless customer requests permanency. No wildcards on Resource.

ops-bot: Job queued: forwarder-staging -> tidewatch (job 6102). ETA ~18m.

tom: Staging test PASSED — PutObject + GenerateDataKey succeed, CloudTrail shows success. Filed CSR-9812 for prod change with audit tag.

sec-bot: CSR-9812 approved with constraints: exact key ARN, principal limited to arn:aws:iam::REDFW:role/log-forwarder, condition aws:SourceAccount = 888899990000, revert scheduled in 2h.

keisha: Great — CS message draft: "During pre-cutover validation we found your KMS policy prevented Redwood's forwarder from writing encrypted logs to your bucket. We've applied a scoped exception in staging and will roll a tightly-scoped prod patch during the maintenance window. If you prefer immediate coverage we can enable a Redwood-managed key temporarily. We'll update within 2 hours."

linh: Send once prod patch is scheduled. Owner: tom, blocker: resolved-in-staging, next: prod-roll (ETA 2h). :white_check_mark:
